materials_manifest.product: digitally printed graphic on 3M heat-applied textured-surface wall film
materials_manifest.spec: textured-surface film heat-conformed to masonry/cinder-block walls

dimensions.note: Two coded sizes; dimensions read from scaled face views at medium confidence.

rules_observations: Contour-cut shapes read as applied spirit marks rather than framed panels, which suits an athletic interior.
craft_observations: Heat-applied textured-surface film conforms the print to the masonry wall texture so the graphic looks integral to the block wall instead of a flat decal floating on it.
Matching overlaminate protects the print against contact wear in a high-traffic athletic space.

aesthetic_notes.note: Cut-to-shape spirit graphics build a branded athletic environment economically without fabricated dimensional signage.
